object_description: compact square volume with a possible additional floor
design_condition: A rotated, set-back volume is placed along the perimeter parallel to the street and tree row, creating well-sunlit outdoor spaces and a clear entrance relationship to the existing school complex.

positive.statement: The project is characterized by clear urban development and sensitive integration into the existing school complex.

position.rationale: The rotated compact mass and surrounding clearances are visible across plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The simple and interesting cluster organization creates ideal spaces for school operations with a high level of flexibility.

position.rationale: The compact grid-defined volume provides the visible anchor for clustered school organization.

positive.statement: Differentiated and diverse outdoor spaces, including the outdoor terrace, are perceived as added value and an additional experience.

position.target: differentiated outdoor spaces and outdoor terrace
position.rationale: Perimeter clearances and the rotated footprint visibly define outdoor spaces around the volume.

positive.statement: The delicate design gives the school complex a new contemporary structure with strong identity.

position.rationale: The consistent grid and crisp square envelope establish the contemporary facade expression.

positive.statement: The very compact cubature provides an optimized building-envelope ratio and a good basis for sustainability requirements.

position.rationale: Compact square massing and a regular perimeter support the envelope-ratio assessment.

positive.statement: The kindergarten benefits from a separate access to its playground, while the classrooms receive light from two sides.

position.rationale: The lower-left perimeter approximates access; two-sided daylight remains programmatically inferred.
